📖 About: An info session introducing international internships, teaching & volunteering opportunities.

- Discover internship options abroad  
- Learn about teaching placements overseas  
- Explore volunteer programs worldwide  
- Get guidance on application steps  
✅ Eligibility:  
- Young people interested in international experience  
- Students and recent graduates  
- Anyone keen on internships, teaching or volunteering abroad

💰 Funding: free  
⏳ Duration: 1 hour

📝 Application Method: Apply by filling out the Google Form

opportunities.text:
🏷️ Internship

🎓 Title: CaCTüS Summer Research Internship 2027
🏫 Organizer: Max Planck Institutes & Tübingen AI Center
📖 About: 3‑month fully funded summer research internship in AI, ML, neuroscience, and cognitive science.
🎁 Benefits:
- Monthly stipend ~€1,350
- Accommodation provided
- Travel cost reimbursement
- Health insurance coverage
- Career workshops & networking
✅ Eligibility:
- Bachelor’s/Master’s in CS, math, physics, engineering, psychology, neuroscience, or cognitive science
- Strong academic record & English proficiency
- Not started PhD by internship period
- Can commit full 90‑day internship
- Applicants from low‑ and middle‑income countries encouraged
🌍 Location: Tübingen or Stuttgart, Germany
💰 Funding: fully funded
⏳ Duration: 3 months (July 1 – Sep 30, 2027)
📅 Deadline: Nov 16, 2026

📝 Application Method: Apply via the official page
🔗 Link: https://www.projects.tuebingen.mpg.de/

opportunities.organizer: Erasmus Mundus DEAI Programme (ULB, UPC, TUW, UCBL, UniPD)

eligibility: Bachelor’s degree (180 ECTS) in CS or related field
Academic record, CS credits, experience considered
opportunities.text:
🏷️ Scholarship

🎓 Title: Erasmus Mundus DEAI Scholarship 2027‑2029  
🏫 Organizer: Erasmus Mundus DEAI Programme (ULB, UPC, TUW, UCBL, UniPD)  
📖 About: 2‑year joint Master in Data Engineering & AI, taught in English across five European universities.  
🎁 Benefits:  
- Full tuition & participation fees covered  
- Full insurance coverage  
- €1,400 monthly living allowance (up to 24 months)  
- Potential total living allowance €33,600  
- Partial scholarship covers tuition only  
✅ Eligibility:  
- Bachelor’s degree (180 ECTS) in CS or related field  
- English B2 (IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL 72)  
- International applicants  
- Academic record, CS credits, experience considered  
- Recommendation letters required  
🌍 Location: Belgium, Spain, Austria, France, Italy  
💰 Funding: fully funded (full scholarship)  
⏳ Duration: 2 years (120 ECTS)  
📅 Deadline: Jan 11, 2027

📝 Application Method: Send your application via email
📞 Contact: bdma_admissions@cs.ulb.ac.be
